mcqs.question: Which of the following statements correctly defines a transversal when two parallel lines are given?

options.A: A line that intersects two or more lines at distinct points.
options.B: A line that is parallel to both given lines.
options.C: A line that coincides with one of the given lines.
options.D: A line that forms right angles with both given lines.

mcqs.answer: A line that intersects two or more lines at distinct points.
mcqs.explanation: A transversal is a line that cuts across two (or more) other lines, meeting each at a different point. It need not be parallel or perpendicular to the lines it cuts. Option A states this definition correctly; the other options describe unrelated relationships.

mcqs.question: Two parallel lines l₁ and l₂ are cut by a transversal t. At the intersection with l₁, the upper‑left angle formed is marked as ∠1. Which angle is the corresponding angle to ∠1 at the intersection with l₂?

options.A: The upper‑left angle at the intersection with l₂.
options.B: The upper‑right angle at the intersection with l₂.
options.C: The lower‑left angle at the intersection with l₂.
options.D: The lower‑right angle at the intersection with l₂.

mcqs.answer: The upper‑left angle at the intersection with l₂.
mcqs.explanation: Corresponding angles occupy the same relative position at each intersection of the transversal with the parallel lines. Since ∠1 is the upper‑left angle on l₁, the upper‑left angle on l₂ is its corresponding angle. The other positions are not corresponding.

mcqs.question: Lines p and q are parallel and are intersected by a transversal r. Angle A lies between p and q on the left side of r, and angle B lies between p and q on the right side of r, both interior to the parallel lines. Which of the following correctly compares angles A and B?

options.A: ∠A and ∠B are equal because they are alternate interior angles.
options.B: ∠A and ∠B are supplementary because they are interior angles on the same side of the transversal.

mcqs.answer: ∠A and ∠B are equal because they are alternate interior angles.
mcqs.explanation: When a transversal cuts two parallel lines, the pair of interior angles that lie on opposite sides of the transversal are called alternate interior angles, and they are equal. Option A states this property. Option B describes consecutive interior angles, not alternate. Options C and D refer to different angle relationships.

mcqs.learning_point: Identify interior angles on the same side of a transversal
mcqs.question: If two parallel lines are intersected by a transversal, what is the sum of the interior angles that lie on the same side of the transversal?
mcqs.explanation: Interior angles on the same side of a transversal (also called consecutive interior or co‑interior angles) are supplementary when the two lines are parallel; therefore their sum is 180°. The other values do not correspond to this geometric property.
